facts.fact: 她到文武庙上香，供的是文章之神与武艺之神
facts.anchor: the gods of literature and martial arts at Man Mo temple

facts.fact: 文昌把毛笔搁在膝上，关帝那边是以他命名的长柄兵器，凶气更重
facts.anchor: Man Cheong holding his writing brush in his lap

facts.fact: 祖母总说文章与武艺同等重要
facts.anchor: Por Por would always say that literature and martial skills were of equal import.

facts.fact: Archie 自称圣公会，觉得在庙里上香近乎亵渎
他犹豫了一下，随手挑了一位神
facts.anchor: Archie looked conflicted before he finally chose a deity at random.

facts.fact: 她只说这位是捉鬼的钟馗，没提自己跟这位神还算沾亲
facts.anchor: “Chung Kwai, god of demon hunting.” She kept the indirect-ancestor part to herself

facts.fact: 她投币抽到的第一支签说失物自归，是大吉
facts.anchor: The lost find their way home. A most auspicious fortune.

facts.fact: Archie 递来的第二支签说莫混天生分开之物，恐有凶事
facts.anchor: Do not mix that which nature kept separate. Misfortune likely.

facts.fact: 妹妹把两人拽向庙尾那座没修完的偏殿
facts.anchor: Jingling had pulled the two of them towards the unfinished hall at the end of the temple.

facts.fact: 她上次来这座偏殿，是为翻幽鬼卷宗查影兽的记载
facts.anchor: consulted the yiugwai scrolls to try and find information on the shadow beast

facts.fact: Hoi 哥一手扶着一柄长关刀站在那里
facts.anchor: Hoi gor stood with one hand on a long guandou

facts.fact: 照片后排有 Fung 屠户、Leung 工头夫妇，以及开祭品铺的 Tang 太太
facts.anchor: including Butcher Fung, Foreman Leung and his wife, and Mrs Tang, who owned the ceremonial-goods shop.

facts.fact: 匾上写礼堂由华人捐建，Ng Choy 与 Yau Yuhuan 出力最多
facts.anchor: in particular Ng Choy and Yau Yuhuan

facts.fact: 她推断出钱修礼堂的人有资格放第一批基石
facts.anchor: they would’ve had the honour of placing the first stones

facts.fact: 她说这座庙是护身符，从祖母被掳那一夜起开始失灵
facts.anchor: A talisman that started failing the night Por Por was abducted.

facts.fact: 她判断对手不必拆庙，只要把基石一块一块抽走
facts.anchor: They just need to pull the foundation stones out, one by one.

facts.fact: 影兽藏在太平山顶，是开合门径的钥匙
facts.anchor: It’s hiding in Victoria Peak, I’m sure of it. It’s the key to the doorways.

facts.fact: 他最后用粤语应下，说去打我们自己的鬼
facts.anchor: “Hou la,” he answered in Cantonese. “Let’s fight our demons.”
